news.title: Jalen Brunson: Knicks' sputtering offense 'falls on my shoulders' amid 0-3 start
news.text: The Knicks lost their third straight game Sunday against the Magic, becoming the first defending champion to open a season 0-3 since the 2011-12 Mavs. "Everything falls on my shoulders," Jalen Brunson said in reference to the team's sputtering offense.

news.title: Wagner, Magic use big fourth quarter to drop Knicks to 0-3 with 111-102 victory
news.text: — Franz Wagner scored 21 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter, and the Orlando Magic dropped the reigning champion New York Knicks to 0-3 with a 111-102 win Sunday night.

news.title: Jayson Tatum scores 36, sizzles down the stretch as Celtics fend off Knicks 107-103
news.text: — Jayson Tatum scored 25 of his 36 points in the second half, including seven of his team’s final eight to help the Boston Celtics hold off the New York Knicks 107-103 on Friday night.

news.title: New York couple names son Knickson Fyve after Knicks title chant
news.text: Vance and Yvonne Bradford's newborn son is named for the popular chant that filled the streets of New York after the Knicks' first title in over 50 years.

news.title: Ex-Laker Dalton Knecht joins Knicks on two-way contract
news.text: Former Lakers first-round pick Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way deal with the Knicks, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.

news.title: Phishing email to Knicks employees an 'unfortunate mistake,' MSG rep says
news.text: A Madison Square Garden spokesperson admitted fault that employees in Knicks business operations and at the arena received a phishing email posing as an opportunity to claim an NBA championship ring, calling the incident "an unfortunate mistake."
